lede: The meeting to watch this week is Thursday's joint work session where the San Miguel County Planning Commission and the Board of County Commissioners sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry practices, oil and gas, geothermal operations, and condominium plats — the kind of code rewrite that shapes how land gets used here for years. Monday's Open Space Commission meeting is also worth attention, with three trail alignment options for Reach 1 of the Valley Floor on the table, plus a Telluride Mountain Club request to route part of a long-planned trail across open space. The week kicks off with Fourth of July celebrations all over town.

notable.stake: Commission picks Valley Floor trail route; Mountain Club access request also decided.
Proposed Land Use Code rewrites on forestry, oil/gas, geothermal, and condo plats discussed.
